description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class CannotStopInactiveOrderException, which extends OrderEntryException, used in the OpenMRS API to indicate an error when attempting to stop an inactive order.

classes.name: CannotStopInactiveOrderException
classes.description: A custom exception thrown when an attempt is made to stop an inactive order in the OpenMRS context.
